actions.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation.

official_title: A bill to require a school that receives support under the E-Rate program of the Federal Communications Commission to allow parents of students attending that school to opt-out of screen-based instruction, and for other purposes.
